coordination.write_strategy: Unique role-local certificate/checkpoint first; update LATEST only by CAS against the observed r126 blob. Repository head advanced after the semantic barrier, but later head observations were used only for write-collision safety and no later control semantics were adopted.

new_public_evidence.source: Huang, Ma and Michailidis, Model-Agnostic Online Certificate-Driven Calibration for Time Series Forecasting Under Distribution Shift, UAI 2026
new_public_evidence.result: Finite-sample martingale certificates under temporal dependence and shift are paired with a gated corrective head that reverts to a fixed backbone and uses predict-then-update timing. This is a strong design motif for a defensive allocation backbone, not a directly transferable theorem.

new_public_evidence.source: Areces, Mohri, Hashimoto and Duchi, Online Conformal Prediction via Online Optimization, ICML 2025
new_public_evidence.result: Online conformal coverage can be controlled on the appropriate time-average object under adversarial sequences, with stronger conditional convergence under additional stochastic structure. This reinforces separating residual-frequency calibration from one-step variance safety.

new_public_evidence.source: Tu and Giesecke, Online Conformal Prediction for Non-Exchangeable Panel Data, 2026
new_public_evidence.result: A two-state method obtains a stepwise bound and long-run guarantee by exploiting contemporaneous related-unit calibration plus delayed target feedback. The required contemporaneous panel is absent here, so the stepwise result is not imported.

new_public_evidence.source: Mastrototaro and Olsson, Adaptive online variance estimation in particle filters: the ALVar estimator
new_public_evidence.result: The targeted source search still did not establish a theorem-clean generation-wise single-run estimator for this independent-stratified multi-generation implementation; keep the resampling-scheme boundary explicit.

derived_results.claim: A continuous genealogy-localization risk cap, tuned on a disjoint discovery family and frozen at c0=0.3, k=8, decay=0.95, reduced the aggressive uncertainty controller's recurring worst ratio from 1.3170 to 1.1700, but did not robustly dominate fixed beta=0.5: fresh recurring validation had mean 0.87846 and worst 1.17002 versus 0.87634 and 1.08831 for fixed beta. The risk signal was active >0.05 on about 97.1% of recurring runs, so noisy genealogy plus long memory behaved too much like a persistent moderate clamp.

A past-only scalar online residual-quantile layer targeted at 90% continuation-diagnostic coverage improved gradual post-hoc true-A box coverage from 0.6653 for the raw uncertainty controller to 0.9417 on a fresh 12-stream validation, with diagnostic coverage 0.9014. Yet recurring mean/worst allocation ratios degraded to 0.88619/1.29484. Better residual-frequency calibration therefore does not provide transient allocation safety.

The stronger cross-field direction is a fixed defensive backbone plus a separately certified corrective allocation. Martingale/certificate-driven online calibration under temporal dependence provides a precedent for predict-then-update gating with fallback. A transfer must certify an observable proxy first and separately prove or test its relationship to true allocation variance.

No theorem-clean single-run generation-wise variance estimator specifically for the independent-stratified multi-generation particle filter was established in the targeted search. This remains a search result, not a nonexistence claim.

engineering_update.scope: 12-generation synthetic two-state Feynman-Kac stress with independent stratified resampling. Risk-controller discovery and validation seed families were disjoint; online residual-scale discovery and validation were also disjoint. Exact A is used only post hoc for scoring/coverage diagnostics.

negative_or_scope_evidence: The simple continuous genealogy argmax/confidence risk map is not an adoption candidate: it reduced some large transients but failed to beat the fixed defensive reserve robustly on recurring validation.
Long risk memory made the cap active most of the time, indicating that the genealogy localizer is too noisy to serve as the primary concentration controller even after smoothing.

The online residual quantile layer is an engineering controller inspired by online conformal/quantile methods; it is not theorem-equivalent to the cited methods and its observed true-A coverage is post-hoc only.
Frequency-style diagnostic calibration did not remove recurring transients; a one-step or martingale-style safety gate is still missing.
No result here implies real-agent or AGI performance, and no theorem from multinomial/adaptive-resampling genealogy was silently transferred to independent stratified resampling.
frontier: Build a certificate-gated defensive-backbone controller. Keep fixed beta=0.5 always available and treat the aggressive uncertainty allocation as a corrective proposal rather than the default.

Construct a bounded, completed-run observable proxy-loss difference between the aggressive proposal and defensive backbone using continuation diagnostics only. Derive a predictable one-sided martingale/confidence-sequence gate for that proxy before increasing concentration on subsequent runs.

Quantify the bridge from proxy ordering to post-hoc exact-A allocation ordering on disjoint synthetic streams. Unless that bridge is itself certified, label the controller proxy-safe rather than variance-safe.

Use online conformal/online optimization only for the residual-frequency object it actually controls; test stronger local/strongly-adaptive variants as calibration layers without conflating them with run-level safety.
Continue the targeted theorem search for independent-stratified single-run generation-wise variance estimation and for dependent-cloud confidence sequences.
exact_next_action: Define q0 from beta=0.5 and q1 from the existing uncertainty controller before each run. After the run, compute both proposals' bounded proxy losses from the same completed continuation diagnostic so the paired difference has a known predictable range. Construct a one-sided anytime-valid betting or empirical-Bernstein confidence sequence for the conditional mean difference using only past observations. Permit q1 or a continuous q0-q1 blend on the next run only after the upper confidence bound supports improvement; otherwise use q0. Tune only a prespecified gate-risk budget on discovery streams, freeze it, validate once on disjoint abrupt/gradual/recurring streams, and separately report agreement/disagreement between proxy certification and post-hoc exact-A ordering.
